gate_criteria.description: Losing one Core process does not destroy a valid committed match; clients reconnect to the surviving process. Same-host deployment is accurately labeled process HA
verified_points: Core A/B process pair redundancy on distinct private upstreams (core-a:8081, core-b:8082) behind existing single edge ingress.
Connection drain protocol gracefully migrates idle connections while allowing active game turns to finish within drain deadline.
Uninterrupted WebSocket reconnect semantics: disconnect triggers client resubscription and state replay without match destruction.
Strict failure domain labeling: multi-process failover accurately designated process HA on same host; host loss recognized as distinct capacity constraint.
Ingress routing health probes actively monitor Core readiness and bypass unready instances without dropped game updates.
